identityModel.isolation: workspace_id + workspace-scoped repository APIs + composite constraints + Service authorization + Gateway Principal + cross-workspace tests; RLS deferred

persistenceModel.evidence: Existing Docker Compose resource; no application driver or migration tool exists.
persistenceModel.adapterPattern: service-owned repository port with memory and PostgreSQL adapters
persistenceModel.transaction: Formal Matter + immutable governed-source snapshot + source hashes/versions + idempotency record + append-only audit; no outbox
persistenceModel.idempotency: unique workspace/command/key with request hash and stable result
persistenceModel.outbox: NOT_IN_MILESTONE_2; process-local events are non-durable and not delivery-guaranteed
persistenceModel.storage: normalized workspace/identity/state/version/index keys plus schema-versioned immutable JSONB snapshots
persistenceModel.local: existing Compose PostgreSQL extended by migrations
persistenceModel.rollback: forward-only shared migrations; expand/migrate/contract for destructive changes
persistenceModel.migrationPolicy: SQL-first, ordered/versioned, clean bootstrap and prior-schema upgrade tests; no ORM automatic schema synchronization; production forward-oriented

durabilityClassification.condition: Not a live dependency for Formal Matter creation; later admission requires immutable snapshot, exact identity/version, content hash and admission time.

testStrategy.restart: create, stop runtimes, restart, reload exact record
testStrategy.tenantIsolation: Workspace A cannot read or mutate Workspace B
testStrategy.browser: authenticated real-runtime desktop create and reload without interception
testStrategy.uiFixtures: Storybook loading, empty, eligible, creating, success, permission, partial, stale, conflict and error

securityBoundary.credentials: no repository credentials; memory-hard password hashing
securityBoundary.session: HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax opaque cookie recommended
securityBoundary.csrf: token and Origin validation for unsafe cookie requests
securityBoundary.tenantScope: mandatory at service, repository and database layers
securityBoundary.roleEnforcement: Gateway and owning service; never UI only
securityBoundary.claims: no production security certification, enterprise SSO or DR claim

risks: No current driver, migration runner, authentication tooling or durable event publisher exists.
A durable Matter cannot depend on disappearing fixture state; snapshot admission is mandatory.
Cross-service identity and Matter transactions cannot share a database transaction.
Tenant scoping omissions can expose customer relationship/private context.
Process-local domain events are non-durable and carry no delivery guarantee in Milestone 2.
RLS is deferred; every repository API, constraint, Service authorization check and cross-workspace test must enforce isolation.
dependencies: MarkReg durable source and Matter repositories

tasks.title: Durable audit, idempotency and event delivery hardening

acceptanceCriteria: authenticated active Workspace member explicitly creates an eligible Formal Matter
exact source identity/version and complete immutable snapshot are stored
Matter has durable opaque ID and version 1
audit and idempotency result commit atomically
identical replay returns the same Matter and conflicting replay fails
stale source and expected-version races write no partial state
restart preserves exact Matter and lineage
cross-Workspace access cannot read or mutate
Gateway and browser evidence use real runtimes and PostgreSQL
no Payment, Filing Submission or other listed external-authority consequence is created
